newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: MAJOR CZECH SHARES CONTINUE FALL, PX50 EASES.
newsitem.headline: MAJOR CZECH SHARES CONTINUE FALL, PX50 EASES.

text.p: Major Czech share prices were down across the board in heavier trading on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday, dragging the bourse index lower for the fifth consecutive session.
SPT Telecom, Komercni Banka, CEZ and Tabak all lost ground and the PX50 index eased 2.3 points, or 0.41 percent, to 553.2.
Overall, 274 shares fell, 260 rose and 155 held steady. Volume was heavier at 904,421 shares on turnover of 593.6 million crowns.
One of the few blue chips to rise was savings bank Ceska Sporitelna, which gained seven crowns to 330.

On the broader market, conference organiser BVV Brno, a traditionally volatile share, was one of the biggest losers, falling 72 crowns to 4,063. Paper maker Sepap was also down sharply with a 60 crown dip to 1,150.
However, glass fibre maker Vertex rose 185 crowns to 3,885 and brewer Radegast moved 55 crowns higher to 4,465.
